title: 12 AI-powered turrets have been installed in Kyiv to combat rocket-propelled "Shaheds"
key_facts: Twelve AI-controlled automated turrets have been installed in Kyiv to counter Shahed drones
Reported by military analyst and communications expert Serhiy 'Flash' Beskrestnov
The turrets are a Ukrainian design with machine guns controlled by AI that shoot down Shaheds
Not independently verified; text is a short relay of one analyst's statement
quote_evidence: Twelve automated turrets equipped with artificial intelligence have been installed in the capital to counter Russian "Shahed" drones.
There are plans to continue deploying such systems equipped with machine guns and artificial intelligence.
why_it_matters_hint: A city is putting AI-aimed gun turrets on guard against drone attacks, per one analyst.
notes: Single-source claim by a named analyst, not an official statement; headline calls them 'rocket-propelled' but the text only says Shahed drones.
